reason: LIVE DEFECT: the API contract and payout code branch on the wire value "saving" (singular; see packages/api-contract/src/bank-account.schema.ts in blindpay-v2 and the payout code's account_type === 'saving' check). This SDK's BankAccountType.savings encodes "savings" (plural), so creating a savings bank account through this SDK is rejected by the API today. node and go already use the correct value; python and php have the same defect as this repo. Fix is deliberately deferred to a separate, reviewed PR per repo (changing an existing public enum's raw value needs its own scrutiny, not a mechanical sync-infra change) rather than silently auto-corrected here.
